@CurrentMain.JsonGlobalCallAdapter.assignedAt_sound : ∀ {n m k : ℕ} {ρ : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} (fuel : ℕ)
  (routeDecoder : CurrentMain.SelectedSourceSyntax.Value → Option ρ) (assignment : Fin k → Fin m → Fin n)
  (store : Fin n → α) (global : Lean.Json) (position : Fin k)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonOwnerFieldAdapter.Matched n m routeDecoder (assignment position)),
  CurrentMain.JsonGlobalCallAdapter.assignedAt fuel n m k routeDecoder assignment global position = some r →
    (∃ calls call raw,
        global.getObjVal? "calls" = Except.ok (Lean.Json.arr calls) ∧
          calls.size = k ∧

                      (CurrentMain.SelectedSourceSyntax.Value.array
                        (List.map CurrentMain.JsonOwnerFieldAdapter.rowValue ↑r)) =
                    raw) ∧
      CurrentMain.JsonGlobalCallAdapter.gatherAt fuel routeDecoder store global position =
        some (List.ofFn fun i => store (assignment position i))

printed_types.printed_type:
@CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.certifyEntry_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (fuel : ℕ) (dictionary : Lean.Json)
  (key : String) (certificateJson : Lean.Json) (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.certifyEntry fuel n dictionary key certificateJson = some r →
    (∃ raw,
        dictionary.getObjVal? key = Except.ok raw ∧
          CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
              (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue r.columns) =
            raw) ∧
      (∃ w,
          CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode fuel (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.witnessValue w) =
              certificateJson ∧
            CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.Binds (↑r.certificate) w) ∧
        CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
            ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
          (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
              CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                  ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
                x) ∧
            ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
              (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                  (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
                x

@CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.arbitrary_payload_cancellation : ∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1}
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n) (f : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n → α),
  (fun x =>
        f
          ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
            (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x))) =
      f ∧
    (fun x =>
        f
          (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
            ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x))) =
      f
